description: This file defines data models related to countries, including a Country interface, a CountryISO enum with country codes, and a CountryData class providing a list of all countries with their details such as name, ISO2 code, dial code, flag, and optional postcode pattern.

classes.name: CountryData
classes.description: A class providing a comprehensive list of country data including name, ISO2 code, dial code, flag, and optional postcode pattern.

methods.name: CountryData.allCountries
methods.description: An array containing country objects with detailed information such as name, ISO2 code, dial code, flag, and postcode pattern.
